description: Search for land parcels in Texas that sit close to a high-voltage substation: powered land for data centers, battery storage, crypto mining or other large loads. Filter by county or by a point and radius, minimum acreage, maximum distance to a substation and minimum substation voltage. Returns parcel acreage, location, property ID, situs address, legal description and appraisal values, and the nearest qualifying substation with its owner. Filter by owner type (company, individual, trust_estate, public, private), and by max_wetland_pct to drop parcels that are largely mapped wetland (USFWS NWI), and by bus_kv_max or osm_class to keep parcels whose nearest substation has a lower-voltage or distribution bus mapped in OpenStreetMap. Set group_by_owner to roll parcels up by landowner and rank owners by total acres near qualifying substations, e.g. 'who controls 200+ acres within a mile of a 138 kV substation'; undivided-interest accounts on the same polygon are counted once. Enterprise Lite and Enterprise: below them it returns the count of qualifying parcels and their acreage, not the parcels or owners. Parcel coverage is limited to the counties listed in the response.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

bus_kv_max.description: Keep parcels whose nearest qualifying substation has a bus at or below this kV (lowest mapped OpenStreetMap voltage, else the listed kV). A 345/138/69 kV station passes bus_kv_max 69 even though min_kv judges it by its top voltage. Not used with group_by_owner.

county.description: Texas county name, e.g. 'Jackson'. Use this or a location.

dist_mapped_only.description: Enterprise. With max_dist_line_mi, count only lines traced in OpenStreetMap, not modeled ones. Mapped coverage is thin in many counties.

gas_interstate.description: Enterprise. Only count interstate (FERC regulated) or intrastate (Railroad Commission regulated) gas lines. Default all.

group_by_owner.description: Group qualifying parcels by landowner and return owners ranked by total acres, with parcel count, largest parcel, prop IDs, nearest substation and mailing address. Needs a county or a location.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

limit.description: Maximum parcels returned. Default 25, max 200. With group_by_owner: owners returned, default 25, max 100.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

max_dist_line_mi.description: Enterprise. Keep parcels whose centroid is within this many miles of a distribution line under 69 kV (OpenStreetMap mapped, plus the gridfinder model unless dist_mapped_only). For small loads and distribution-connected solar or storage, typically under 10 MW. Adds nearest_dist_line_mi and dist_line_basis. Measured on the first 80 parcels after the other filters.

max_fiber_mi.description: Enterprise. Keep parcels within this many miles of a mapped fiber route (provider GIS or carrier corridor). Adds nearest_fiber_mi and nearest_fiber_provider. Measured on the first 80 parcels after the other filters.

max_gas_mi.description: Enterprise. Keep parcels within this many miles of a mapped natural gas pipeline (RRC; see min_gas_diameter_in and gas_interstate). Straight-line distance to the mapped line. Not used with group_by_owner.

max_sub_mi.description: Maximum distance from parcel to substation in miles. Default 3, max 10.

max_wetland_pct.description: Drop parcels where more than this percent of the area is mapped wetland or open water (USFWS National Wetlands Inventory), e.g. 10. Every returned parcel carries wetland_pct and wetland_acres either way. Not used with group_by_owner.

measure_terrain.description: Enterprise. Add flat_pct, mean_slope_pct and wells_active without filtering.

min_acres.description: Minimum parcel size in acres. Default 5, minimum 5.

min_flat_pct.description: Enterprise. Minimum percent of the parcel under 5 percent slope (USGS 3DEP). Adds flat_pct, mean_slope_pct and wells_active to each parcel.

min_gas_diameter_in.description: Enterprise. Only count gas lines of at least this diameter in inches (for example 12) when measuring nearest_gas_mi.

min_kv.description: Minimum substation voltage in kV. Default 138.

min_parcel_acres.description: With group_by_owner: smallest parcel counted toward an owner's total. Default 5, minimum 1 (below 5 acres the radius is capped at 10 miles).

min_total_acres.description: With group_by_owner: only owners holding at least this many acres in total. Default 50.

osm_class.description: Keep parcels whose nearest qualifying substation has this OpenStreetMap class. distribution means a distribution bus is mapped. Stations not mapped in OpenStreetMap are dropped. Not used with group_by_owner.

owner_type.description: Landowner type, classified from the appraisal district owner name. private = everything except government, school districts and other public owners. Default any (private when group_by_owner is set).

radius_mi.description: Radius around the location in miles. Default 10, max 50.

same_side_of_rail.description: Enterprise. Keep only parcels with no active railroad between the parcel and its own nearest qualifying substation (straight line, TxDOT/FRA rail). Every parcel then carries rail_crossings and rail_lines.

name: find_powered_land
title: Find powered land
